title: Could you be wrong: Debiasing LLMs using a metacognitive prompt for improving human decision making
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks and prompts used were designed to measure implicit discriminatory biases (gender stereotypes), failures of metacognition (reasoning about fictional medical conditions), and evidence omission (related to a psychological effect).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the investigation.
